page.overview:
Who is Gaunter O'Dimm?

Gaunter O'Dimm, also called Master Mirror, is a supernatural bargainer encountered in The Witcher 3's Hearts of Stone story.

Also known as: Master Mirror, Man of Glass, O'Dimm.
